metadata.note_ilm: Beats perform index-template and lifecycle setup on EVERY connect, not just during 'beat setup'. Without these two cluster privileges the output connection fails with 'onConnect callback failed' and the shipper silently delivers nothing.
metadata.note_indices: Index 'manage' is deliberately excluded so a compromised endpoint cannot delete the SOC's own evidence indices. Verify with: curl -u soc-beats:PW -XDELETE <es>/auditbeat-test  -> expect 403
